w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: They argued over names for 4 beasts — 4 words, 4 debates: "Big-Eyes" (2), "Ugly-Eyes" (2), "Old Gavel" (2), "Loud-Eyes" (2).

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: You catch Oliver telling the fire about Colleen. "Colleen came back mauled by The Terms of Service (4 rounds, 42 taken) and alive. Three white lines across the forearm now." The story's already growing.

w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Cancellation.
firstContext: ◈ RELAY ABILITY — Faithful Carry: Messages arrive undistorted — no gossip decay while you carry them.
Something moves out there — The Cancellation.
👁️ Hattie freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
🚪 BARRIER CROSSED — you crash through to a new area, but they're right behind you — through the barrier! (The edge of the grid is an exit. The chase continues.)

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Rerun.
firstContext: The face slips — for a second it's just... wrong, and everyone sees it.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "Ugly-Eyes." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
⚠ DEHYDRATED: find and treat water today.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (25/15/7), with 5 wave-4 and 1 wave-5 fought, 10 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 3 · Craft 3 · Talk 16 · Explore 33 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Aria Thompson ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store has fallen far from its recent high — the shelves are nearly bare.
⚠ The store has fallen far from its recent high again — the shelves are nearly bare.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,264 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.
